lab_launcher.title: Live Client-Side Diagnostic Tools
lab_launcher.description: 100% direct browser-to-target execution with zero server telemetry, zero IP proxying, and zero query logging.

lab_launcher.doh_pitch: Benchmark real-time DNS resolution latency, audit upstream DNS poisoning, and verify RFC 8484 resolver answers directly from your browser.

lab_launcher.fingerprint_pitch: Analyze client hardware entropy by computing deterministic 2D Canvas render hashes, WebGL GPU vendor strings, and AudioContext frequency signatures.
